title: Allen Dulles cuts off Ruth Paine's Warren Commission testimony

tellings.difference: Says outright that what Dulles was hiding was her presence at the summer house, and credits Mary Bancroft.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe Dulles keeping Ruth Paine's testimony from revealing her stay at the summer house with his mistress's circle. This matches Levenda's account of Dulles stopping her at the Warren Commission hearing.

as_told.title: Dulles hides Ruth Paine's visit to the summer house

plain: In 1964, at the Warren Commission, the panel that investigated Kennedy's killing, the former CIA director Allen Dulles is said to have cut off a witness named Ruth Paine while she was testifying. The writer Peter Levenda tells Michels this from his reading of the Warren Commission volumes, the commission's published record. In his words, Dulles "is part of that committee hearing. He stops her." Michels tells it himself on another episode and says what Dulles was hiding. In his telling, Dulles "did not want the fact that Ruth Paine had actually been at the summer house" to come out. Michels credits this to a woman named Mary Bancroft. Levenda does not say what was being hidden. They tell it because, if true, a CIA man steered what went into the official record of the assassination.
